# Westviertel – Materialset v2

Neun ursprüngliche Materialflächen wurden als ein Texturatlas mit dem eingebauten `image_gen`-Tool erzeugt. `tools/build-west-textures.cjs` schneidet die Flächen aus, gleicht die äußeren Kanten an und speichert pro Fläche eine 512px-JPEG-Diffuskarte sowie eine geglättete Graustufen-Höhenkarte. Straße, Pflaster, Hofboden und Beton verwenden die Höhenkarten als Bump-Maps; die übrigen Höhenkarten liegen für spätere Materialvarianten bereit. Die Karten sind keine gemessenen PBR-Scans.

Dateien: `asphalt`, `paving`, `yard`, `plaster`, `brick`, `concrete`, `wood`, `steel`, `ballast`; jeweils `.jpg` und `-height.jpg`.

Für die Aufbereitung benötigt das Werkzeug `sharp`; der Modulpfad kann über `ZERO_RISE_SHARP` gesetzt werden. Die fertigen JPEGs benötigen im Spiel keine Bildverarbeitung.

## Generierungs-Prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a single production-ready game surface texture atlas for a worn European neighborhood. Create a SQUARE 3 by 3 grid of nine equal square seamless texture tiles, edge-to-edge, no borders, gutters, text or labels. Orthographic flat scans with completely even diffuse lighting, no perspective, no sun shadows, no objects, no vignettes, no baked reflections. All tiles must be naturally repeatable. High material detail and realistic restrained grey/earth color palette. EXACT layout: top-left aged dark grey asphalt with fine aggregate, irregular repaired fissures and shallow worn patches; top-middle old large square grey concrete sidewalk slabs with chipped corners, thin dirty joints and sparse moss in joints (4 by 4 slabs); top-right compacted grey-brown gravel and soil with a few muted moss remnants, no flowers or large plants. Middle-left weathered ochre beige plaster with flaking areas revealing red brick beneath, hairline cracks, realistic granular surface (roughly 85 percent plaster, no giant patches); middle-middle old muted reddish brown European brick wall with uneven faded mortar, running bond; middle-right dirty aged grey cast concrete with subtle board-form seams and water stains. Bottom-left weathered grey-brown timber boards, grain and chipped worn surface; bottom-middle old painted dark grey-green steel with restrained rust chips and scratches, flat metal rather than corrugated shapes; bottom-right worn grey railway ballast, angular small stones mixed with dusty dirt. Tile scale about 3-4 metres square except brick/timber which show enough units for repeating. This is a bitmap texture atlas to be cropped and mapped onto actual 3D geometry, NOT an art guide or rendered scene. No frames, icons, captions, buildings, people, leaves, puddle reflections, logos or watermarks.
